**References:** [IData](./gramstax.idata.md)<!-- -->, [IOptCallbackAnswer](./gramstax.ioptcallbackanswer.md)

## Remarks

Template-backed counterpart to answering inline-button taps: the `<g-callback-answer>` block supplies the notification text. There is no message to send, so this takes no keyboard and never falls back to a reply. Toast text is limited by Telegram to 200 characters.
